name: Cadherin adhesion with E-cadherin turnover and cadherin-11 signaling
rationale: All members concern cadherin-based adherens junctions and their EMT context (CDH1 processing, degradation, Listeria InlA binding, CDH11 interactions/STAT3), and the protein-level CDH1/CDH11 regulation distinguishes it from junction-organization and cadherin-transcription confusables.

name: Hindbrain, cranial nerve and enteric nervous system development
rationale: Members cover brainstem/pons maturation, branchiomotor, trigeminal and facial nerve development and brainstem-driven behaviours, and the enteric/autonomic neural crest and peristalsis members separate it from spinal cord and cranial ganglion confusables.

name: Vascular smooth muscle phenotypic switching and vessel remodeling
rationale: All members regulate vascular smooth muscle differentiation, dedifferentiation, proliferation, migration and apoptosis in remodeling, distinguishing it from cardiac muscle and endothelial confusables.

name: Golgi vesicle sorting to lysosomes and lysosome-related organelles
rationale: Members describe coat-dependent cargo sorting from the Golgi to lysosomes and lysosome-related organelles (melanosomes, platelet dense granules, synaptic vesicles), unlike the melanin-pigmentation, endocytic clathrin and generic lysosome-biogenesis confusables.

name: Cardiac chamber myocardium and conduction system development
rationale: Members cover heart tube, second heart field, ventricular/atrial myocardium and trabeculation plus sinoatrial, atrioventricular and His-Purkinje conduction system development, setting it apart from valve/cushion, septum and outflow-tract confusables.

qualifier: sex steroid (estrogen, androgen, progesterone) and thyroid
name: Sex steroid and thyroid hormone nuclear receptor signaling
rationale: Members are estrogen, androgen, progesterone and thyroid hormone receptor signaling and response programmes, distinguishing it from retinoic acid, hepatic, estrous-cycle and RUNX2/bone confusables.

name: Rod and cone visual retinoid cycle and its defects
rationale: Members are the rod and cone retinoid (visual) cycle, its ABCA4/RDH5/RDH12 defects and A2E by-product formation, distinguishing it from general retinoid metabolism and phototransduction confusables.

name: De novo purine nucleotide biosynthesis
rationale: All members are de novo IMP/AMP purine nucleotide synthesis, distinct from pyrimidine synthesis, purine salvage and folate confusables.

name: Axon guidance and innervation of monoaminergic and peripheral neurons
rationale: Members concern axon guidance and projection extension of specific neuron types (dopaminergic, serotonergic, sympathetic, dorsal root ganglion), unlike cranial-nerve and netrin/semaphorin signaling confusables.

name: Non-vesicular intermembrane transfer of phospholipids and glycosphingolipids
rationale: Members are protein-mediated lipid transfer between membranes (PI/PC, glycolipids, ceramide-1-phosphate), with glycosphingolipid transfer separating it from flippase, ER-tethering and phospholipid-synthesis confusables.

name: Purine nucleobase salvage by HPRT1
rationale: All members are HPRT1-mediated salvage of hypoxanthine/guanine to IMP/GMP, distinct from nucleoside salvage and purine catabolism confusables.

name: Urea cycle, ammonia homeostasis and their inborn errors
rationale: Members cover the urea cycle, its enzyme/transporter deficiencies, and linked arginine, ornithine, glutamate/glutamine and aspartate nitrogen metabolism, unlike proline, glycine-conjugation and generic amino-acid confusables.

core: Meiotic chromosome segregation and cell-cycle control
name: Meiotic chromosome segregation and cell-cycle control in oocytes
rationale: Members concern meiotic cohesion, spindle, chromosome alignment/segregation and meiotic phase transitions, largely female meiosis, distinguishing it from recombination/synapsis and male-meiosis confusables.

name: Lipoxygenase eicosanoid turnover with platelet-activating factor metabolism
rationale: Members are synthesis and omega-oxidative inactivation of lipoxygenase products (HETEs, lipoxins, LTB4), and PAF/ether lipid catabolism distinguishes it from leukotriene-receptor and P450 eicosanoid confusables.

name: Vesicle docking and priming for glutamate and acetylcholine release
rationale: Members are SNARE-dependent vesicle docking/priming and glutamate/acetylcholine release cycles, unlike calcium-triggered fusion, Rab signaling and monoamine release confusables.

name: PPAR-driven white adipogenesis with circadian and PGC-1alpha control
rationale: Members are nuclear receptor/coactivator transcription of white adipocyte differentiation, PPAR and PGC-1alpha mitochondrial programmes and BMAL/ROR/REV-ERB clock control, unlike gluconeogenic, LXR, circadian-only and fat-pad confusables.

name: Ionizing-radiation G2 checkpoint via p53 and CDC25A turnover
rationale: Members are the radiation-induced G2 checkpoint acting through p53 phosphorylation/degradation (COP1) and CDC25A degradation, unlike GTSE1/MASTL mitotic-progression and p53 repair-transcription confusables.

name: Complement and antimicrobial protein defense against microbes
rationale: Members are complement activation/regulation, defensins, neutrophil granule antimicrobial and metal-sequestering proteins and host-microbe interactions, distinguishing it from hypersensitivity, macrophage/TLR and neutrophil chemotaxis confusables.

core: Hormonal and nutrient control of fuel metabolism
name: Glucagon and glucose-sensing transcriptional control of fuel metabolism
rationale: Members are glucagon/PKA/PDE3B and glucose/ChREBP/AMPK regulation of gluconeogenesis and triglyceride metabolism, unlike adipogenesis, insulin/glucose-uptake and glycogen confusables.

name: Aggresome formation and aggrephagy
rationale: All members concern aggresome assembly and its autophagic clearance, distinct from stress granule, ERAD, chaperone-mediated autophagy and refolding confusables.

Only four members share Fanconi anemia monoubiquitination/ICL repair, while the rest are unrelated modules (polycomb chromatin, RB1/BCL2L1 survival, mitochondrial housekeeping, centrosome, ribosome assembly, inner cell mass proliferation) with no common biological theme.

core: Transition metal ion transport and homeostasis
name: Iron, heme, copper and manganese transport and homeostasis
rationale: Members are uptake, transport and homeostasis of iron (transferrin, heme, ferroportin), copper, manganese and cobalt, unlike oxygen transport, cadmium/metallothionein and scavenger-receptor confusables.

name: COPII and COPI vesicle budding in ER-Golgi transport
rationale: Members are COPII ER export/cargo concentration and COPI anterograde/retrograde budding between ER and Golgi, unlike tethering, intra-Golgi and Golgi-organization confusables.

name: Testis determination and male gonad and germ cell development
rationale: Members are male sex determination, testis differentiation (Sertoli, Leydig, AMH) and germ cell migration/proliferation, distinguishing it from genital tract, ovarian follicle and female reproductive confusables.

name: Formyl peptide receptor-driven neutrophil recruitment and degranulation
rationale: Members are neutrophil recruitment, migration control, FPR signaling and degranulation, with FPR and degranulation separating it from chemotaxis/extravasation and monocyte inflammatory confusables.
